name: revdiff-dual-revision-source-inspection
instr:
Add source inspection without changing review or editor behavior.

ContentRequest returns byte-exact ContentResult data and metadata, explicit ContentUnavailable or ErrContentUnavailable, or a typed failure naming the path and ContentSide. Empty available content is not absent. Preserve revisions, working-copy parents, ranges, rename origins, additions, deletions, untracked files, and special-character paths. Hg.ReadContent translates accepted Git-shaped refs to native revisions; staging does not affect either exact side.

CompareReader.ReadContent and DirectoryReader.ReadContent expose exact operand or current filesystem bytes. Distinguish binary, empty, symlink, absent, and non-regular outcomes from unavailable history. Context-only directory reviews have no historical base. FallbackRenderer.ReadContent follows the visible source choice, never the losing source. IncludeFilter.ReadContent and ExcludeFilter.ReadContent apply normalized scope to direct requests; excluded paths remain unavailable through Model's provider. StdinReader.ReadContent and MultiFileStdinReader.ReadContent return only exact supplied sides and never invent bytes.

Model.InspectSource accepts results only while request sequence and selected file identity match. SourceSpec shows path and side, distinguishing loading, failure, unavailable, empty, text, and binary. Render text without byte reinterpretation and binary as deterministic byte metadata without raw terminal control bytes. Do not broaden editor av
